find_video_under_cursor.description: Find the video under or nearest the cursor on Home, channel pages, the watch sidebar and the main player.
steps: elementsFromPoint(cursor): an inline preview (ytd-video-preview) -> its link; a tile (yt-lockup-view-model / ytm-shorts-lockup-view-model) -> its watch?v= or /shorts/ link; the main player -> ytd-watch-flexy[video-id]
otherwise the nearest visible tile within a small distance
ID = the 11 characters after v= or /shorts/
find_video_under_cursor.evidence: The highlighted tile's link carries the ID that is saved.

list_playlists.description: List the account's playlists (ID, title, privacy) and whether a given video is in each.
steps: POST /youtubei/v1/playlist/get_add_to_playlist {context, videoIds:[id]} with the session's SAPISID hash headers
list_playlists.evidence: HTTP 200 and a playlists array (103 on the test account).
list_playlists.notes: containsSelectedVideos lags 5-10 s (up to ~30 s) behind changes: list playlists with it, never decide an add on it alone.

read_playlist.description: Read a playlist's real entries (videoId, setVideoId).
steps: next page: the continuationItemRenderer in that same list -> POST /youtubei/v1/browse {continuation}; items in onResponseReceivedActions[].appendContinuationItemsAction.continuationItems
read_playlist.evidence: Entries match the playlist page; current immediately after a change.
read_playlist.notes: 100 entries per page; 15-21 s for 1,612 videos (16 pages). Unavailable videos are not returned. A page also has an unrelated section continuation - do not follow it.

add_video.description: Add one video to a playlist.
preconditions: Not already in the playlist (local copy, then the flag) - YouTube allows duplicates
add_video.retry: never automatically: an add that may have happened is checked by reading, not repeated
add_video.sensitive: changes the user's playlist; each repeat creates a duplicate

remove_entry.description: Remove exactly one entry (duplicate repair only).
remove_entry.evidence: STATUS_SUCCEEDED; that entry gone, other entries untouched (verified live).
remove_entry.sensitive: destructive: only for an entry the extension itself created, when the same video appears twice
remove_entry.notes: ACTION_REMOVE_VIDEO_BY_VIDEO_ID removes every copy at once - never use it.
